scope_note: Analyst-modeled syntheses use cited already-public source claims, reported bands, public benchmarks, statutes, and explicit assumptions. The study sends no public-records requests, private data requests, surveys, questionnaires, or other solicitations. Modeled values are not reported facts, metered observations, audited payroll, claimed tax credits, or causal impact estimates. Every interval identifies its kind; sensitivity envelopes and reported bands are not statistical confidence intervals.
